Author: Lénile
Name: DressSaver
Punchline: Saves your character's current outfit as a clean Penumbra mod, with its Glamourer design.
Description:
Saves the outfit your character is wearing (clothes, accessories, hairstyle, makeup) as a clean, well-organized Penumbra mod (.pmp), along with its Glamourer design. Detects conflicts with your other outfits and suggests free items to move pieces onto.

Command: /drss (or /dresssaver)
